meta.tracking_id_status: Supplied by the operator. Applied by this build as the ?tag= parameter on every outbound Amazon product link, because Program Policies 2(b) requires the Associates ID to appear as a URL parameter. Whether the ID is actually assigned to an active Associates account cannot be checked without account access (FLG-003).
meta.method: Each supplied link was requested through a page fetcher that follows redirects, on 2026-11-20. The final URL, the page title and the category breadcrumb were read and transcribed. P-01 through P-03 and P-05 resolved on the first request; P-04 returned Amazon's checkout interstitial twice and resolved on the third request. Nothing was inferred from a search result.
meta.field_rule: intended_asin (what the owner meant to ship) and observed_asin (what the link actually opened) are separate fields and are never merged. Where a field could not be established it is null.
meta.price_rule: Program Policies §2(b) (SRC-02) permits showing price and availability only where Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or where it arrives via Creators API / PA API. Neither is connected, so no price, star rating, review count or stock status appears for any product on this site.
meta.test_rule: Nothing here was handled, cooked with, measured or tested. No product is ranked, scored or named a winner.
meta.affiliate_url_rule: listing_url is the bare /dp/ address that was actually observed. affiliate_url is that address plus ?tag=shopnow047c-20 and is the only Amazon product URL linked outbound. The two are stored separately so a reviewer can tell a measured destination from a constructed one.
